acidification.caveat: Surface ocean pH is an observation-based biogeochemical reconstruction from in-situ carbon and satellite-linked variables, not a direct measurement from space.

provenance.status_note: Requires Copernicus Marine credentials (COPERNICUSMARINE_SERVICE_USERNAME / PASSWORD) to download NetCDF pH reconstructions.

vessels_summary.caveat: A SAR detection with no AIS match is a lead for maritime review, not proof of illegal fishing. Coverage depends on Sentinel-1 passes.

provenance.source: Global Fishing Watch API v3 (AIS Fishing Effort)

historical_oil_cases.title: Ennore / Kamarajar Port Collision Spill
historical_oil_cases.caveat: SAR shows dark patches that may be oil ("possible slick"). Look-alikes include low-wind zones (< 2 m/s), algal films, and rain cells. Wind data reduces false alarms; it does not remove them.
